$comment: PDIG Canonical State Machines — machine-readable. All three platforms MUST implement these transition tables verbatim. Illegal transitions must throw/reject; they must never be silently coerced.

derivedStatus.name: PlanEffectiveStatus
derivedStatus.rule: isStale(plan, currentGraphRevision) => workflowState NOT IN (completed, cancelled) AND currentGraphRevision > lastAnalyzedGraphRevision

guards.rule: completeAction on a plan whose workflowState is completed or cancelled MUST be rejected
completeAction / verifyActionManually / suggestVerificationFromEvidence with an unknown actionId MUST be rejected

invariants: INV-15: after any sequence, ChangePlan.lastAnalyzedGraphRevision <= current graphRevision
INV-16: ready_with_known_scope requires revision current AND all must_change resolved
INV-17: a completed plan is never rewritten by a later rebase
PRB-009/010: completed and cancelled plans are historical and are not rebased
